name: VET Student Loans Ombudsman
summary: A free, independent complaints service for students with a VET Student Loan or VET FEE-HELP debt who have a problem with their provider.
who: Students who have a VET FEE-HELP or VET Student Loan debt.
The complaint must be about the debt, for example a wrong loan amount, charges after you stopped participating, misleading information or a cancelled enrolment.
how: Complain to your education provider first.
Then use the Ombudsman's online complaint form, or complain by phone, in person or in writing.
catches: Category is the closest fit: this is a complaints service about VET loan debts.
